'''''Dinko''''' was a group of [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]] protecting the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Relentless (Sunaj IV)|''Relentless'']]. They were destroyed by [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] in a [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]]. The ''Relentless'' itself soon shared the same fate.
